[[Vatlaaw Doomtooth]] is a [[Charr]] [[ranger]] [[boss]] who first appears in [[Lakeside County]] to the south of [[Ashford]] during the quest [[Trouble in the Woods]]. He spawns on the left side of the road towards [[Regent Valley]], near where the citizens are standing (before you start the quest), and escapes into Regent Valley when approached. He used [[The Catacombs]] to traverse across Ascalon unseen, where he had lost a [[Sharp Charr Tooth|tooth]] to [[Oberan the Reviled]]'s undead, as explained during the quest [[Charr in the Catacombs]].

Defeating Vatlaaw is also the final objective to completing the [[Ascalon Academy]] [[mission]], and upon defeating him and his party you trigger a [[The Searing (cinematic)|cinematic]] depicting [[the Searing]]. You are then transported to [[Old Ascalon]] after a two-year time jump forward.

==Notes==
* During Trouble in the Woods, it is actually possible to kill Vatlaaw. See the quest page for details. 
** This does not affect his role later in the [[Ascalon Academy]] mission.
** Being considered a boss, if killed during [[Anniversary Celebration]], he may drop [[Battle Isle Iced Tea]], [[Delicious Cake]] or [[Party Beacon]] (though the bosses in the [[Northlands]] are usually a better target for [[farm]]ing purposes). 
* Vatlaaw Doomtooth uses both Ignite Arrows and Barrage. Barrage will remove Ignite Arrows when used.
* Vatlaaw Doomtooth is also one of only two enemies in [[pre-Searing]] who has an [[elite skill]]. The other is Bill, the [[Rogue Bull]].  Despite them having elite skills, due to the timeline within the game, you cannot use a [[Signet of Capture]] on either of them.
** In {{reforgedmode}}, elite skills are also used in pre-Searing by [[Grawl Crone]]s, [[Grawl Fighter]]s, and [[Maz Scourgeheart]].

{{anomaly|Unlike most other [[Prophecies]] bosses, Vatlaaw does not have [[Natural Resistance]].}}
